name: one cover held while its proof swaps beside it
looks: A single product cover sits fixed on one side of the frame while a headline types on beside it. A short checklist builds top to bottom with a check mark per line, then that panel is replaced by a dark terminal panel typing out a real command and its result, the cover never moving through either swap.
build: The cover is a fixed DOM panel (ui-tilt-card's held-panel mechanic, no tilt needed if the brief is flat); the checklist lines fade/rise in on a short stagger, each with a check-mark pop; the panel then cross-fades to a mono terminal block revealed with kit.typeOn and a blinking cursor.
sound: A light tick per checklist line, then a soft mechanical key tick under the terminal's type-on.
prompt: Hold one product panel fixed on one side of the frame while its proof swaps beside it: a short checklist building top to bottom with a check mark per line, then crossfading into a terminal panel typing out a real command and its result, so the one fixed cover earns two different kinds of proof in turn.
